target: acceptances 5+6 — split produces an expand and a contract spec, both profile: hardened, joined by depends_on so the contract is unclaimable until the expand is done
cmd: mkdir -p s; cp "$FIXTURES/irreversible/drop_column.md" s/810-thing.md; FACTORY_SPECS_DIR="$PWD/s" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" split s/810-thing.md >/dev/null 2>&1; c=$?; exp=$(ls s | grep -c "expand"); con=$(ls s | grep -c "contract"); ph=$(grep -h "^profile:" s/*expand*.md s/*contract*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -c hardened); dep=$(grep -h "^depends_on:" s/*contract*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -c "[0-9]"); printf '{"c":%s,"expand":%s,"contract":%s,"hardened":%s,"linked":%s}' "$c" "$exp" "$con" "$ph" "$dep"
